elements.name: row of large side windows along left wall
worn passenger seat backs receding toward far end of bus
young passenger in nearest seat by window
seen from behind and slightly to the side, face hidden
arm and shoulders above worn seat back
backpack resting on empty seat beside him
steep forested Ethiopian highland slopes through windows

notes: Extend the painting to all four edges with no paper margin, show a row of seat backs receding along the left wall with him seated forward-facing so the seat back hides his lower body, move the backpack off his shoulders onto the empty seat beside him, and give him closed-toe moulded sandals.
